title: Lead timeline aggregation and activity stamping
objective: One chronological timeline per lead combining status changes, follow-ups, notes, and quote events; last_activity_at maintained on every lead/quote write so inactivity expiry and stalled rules are accurate, with quote activity counting as lead activity (spec FR-44 timeline portion, PRD 10.4 Expire, §11.5).
scope: Activity stamping for all lead- and quote-touching writes
implementation_details: Features/Leads/GetTimeline/GetLeadTimelineQuery: unions lead_status_history, quote_status_history (all quotes of the lead, entries labeled with quote_ref), follow_ups, lead_notes into TimelineEntryDto {type: 'status'|'quote_status'|'follow_up'|'note', at, actorName, title, detail, quoteRef?}; ordered newest first; paged (50)

Infrastructure/Persistence/LeadActivityStampingInterceptor.cs (or explicit calls in LeadOperationExecutor/QuoteOperationExecutor): any insert/update touching a lead, its assignments, follow-ups, notes, quotes, quote versions, or attachments sets leads.last_activity_at = now; implemented centrally in the two operation executors plus Create/Update handlers to stay explicit (no reflection-based tracking)
GetLead DTO extended with lastFollowUp/nextFollowUp prominence fields and overdue flag (next_follow_up_date < today while open)

findings.description: Missed activity-stamp site: BulkReassignCommandHandler (T-018) mutates a lead's accountable-owner assignment but never bumps leads.last_activity_at, contradicting the task objective ('last_activity_at maintained on every lead/quote write') and the LeadActivityStamper docstring ('every insert/update that touches a lead, its assignments...'). The single-lead Assign/Reassign path (LeadOperationExecutor) DOES stamp unconditionally, so two paths performing the same logical mutation behave inconsistently. Consequence for T-023: a manager who bulk-reassigns stalled leads does NOT reset their inactivity clock, so freshly-reassigned leads stay immediate LeadInactivityExpiryJob auto-expiry candidates - the opposite of the reassignment's intent, and a direct inaccuracy in the very expiry input this task exists to keep accurate.
findings.evidence: src/api/QuoteIQ.Application/Features/Leads/BulkReassign/BulkReassignCommandHandler.cs:68-103 (per-lead loop updates LeadAssignment.UserId / AddAssignmentAsync + audit, no LeadActivityStamper.Stamp / no lead.LastActivityAt); contrast LeadOperationExecutor.cs:137 (unconditional Stamp on every single-lead op incl. reassign); LeadActivityStamper.cs:9-11 docstring claims assignments covered; BulkReassignTests.cs has zero LastActivityAt assertions.
findings.recommendation: In the BulkReassign per-lead loop call LeadActivityStamper.Stamp(lead) (the lead is already loaded) before/with the SaveChangesAsync in the existing transaction; add integration test BulkReassign_ShouldBumpLeadLastActivityAt capturing before/after like the other bump tests. (If the team instead decides admin reassignment should deliberately NOT count as activity, that must be an explicit documented decision reconciled with the single-Assign path + the stamper docstring - currently it is an undocumented inconsistency, not a decision.)
findings.resolution: Verified fix iteration 2 (evaluator independent audit). LeadActivityStamper.Stamp(lead) at BulkReassignCommandHandler.cs:83 INSIDE the per-lead foreach loop on the FindAsync-tracked lead, so every lead in the batch is stamped. ATOMIC: runs inside the pre-existing _unitOfWork.ExecuteInTransactionAsync (line 69) and is flushed by the in-loop SaveChanges in BOTH branches (existing-assignment SaveChangesAsync :99-100; new-assignment AddAssignmentAsync internal SaveChanges :88-95) sharing the ambient DbContext/transaction, so it commits/rolls back with the reassignment + per-lead audit; no separate/second save introduced. ADDITIVE: only the single Stamp line added; validation/owner-resolution/eligibility/branching/audit/save-count unchanged. Precedent real (CreateQuoteCommandHandler:150 same static-no-DI shape). New test BulkReassign_ShouldBumpLeadLastActivityAt seeds 2 leads, asserts strict-greater LastActivityAt on BOTH after the bulk call (reads committed value via IgnoreQueryFilters) - would fail if the stamp were hoisted out of the loop or missed a lead. Existing BulkReassign tests (WithoutNote 422, WithNote swap+audit-per-lead) unchanged + pass. Only BulkReassignCommandHandler + BulkReassignTests touched. Evaluator independent suite 589/589 (Domain 259, Application 28, Infrastructure 45, Api 257), no flakes.
